Subject: NovaHealth RFP — benchmarking ask and possible top-up

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week. As we discussed during the call, NovaHealth is running a short RFP window focused on throughput and cost comparisons across three vendors (yourself included). The procurement and ML teams are aligned on a tight benchmark schedule (target: Nov 29 — Dec 10).

Given the scope, we need a short trial extension and a modest credit allocation specifically for head-to-head throughput runs and a limited set of production-like prompts. Can Redwood provide: 1) a 30-day extension to our evaluation window, and 2) an evaluation credit that covers at least the initial 100k tokens (we estimate ~80–120k tokens for the benchmark runs)?

We realize this is a promotional ask — we're open to a conditional approach (e.g., credits applied only to dedicated benchmark project, NDAs in place, and a short MoU restricting the scope). Procurement would like a written note with eligibility terms to present to leadership.

Attached: RFP summary (nova_rfp_requirements.pdf) and an initial cost spreadsheet (cost_breakdown.xlsx).

Timeline is tight — would appreciate a written response by next Tuesday (Nov 17) if possible so we can finalize the internal approvals.

Best,
Sam Jenkins
Sr. Manager, Vendor Evaluation — NovaHealth

Naomi — thanks for flagging. Short answer: we can say yes conditionally. A few concrete guardrails I recommend: 

- Offer a conditional evaluation credit equivalent to $7,500 (approx. 100k tokens under our standard pricing bands) dedicated to benchmark runs only. Credits expire 30 days after issuance.
- Require signed MOU limiting usage to benchmarking activity and forbidding production traffic. MOU should reference the RFP attachment and include a short dataset handling clause (no customer PII in samples).
- Attach an audit clause: we reserve the right to review the benchmark queries and request redaction if they attempt to test disallowed behaviours.
- If procurement insists on a cap in tokens rather than dollar-value, we can state a firm token cap (100,000 tokens) and a hard stop once used.

Operationally, finance needs the HubSpot deal ID and a short note from procurement saying this is evaluation-only. Legal should get a quick MOU and NDA — Vanessa can take the lead there.

Aditya — pricing/discount lanes? Is $7.5k within field approvals or do we need a manager sign-off?

-Markus
VP Strategic Accounts

Agree with Markus — I support the conditional offer. Action items: 

- Vanessa: please prepare a 1-page MOU + NDA stub we can email to NovaHealth. Keep the language narrow: evaluation-only, token cap (100,000 tokens) or $7,500 credit, 30-day expiration, no production traffic, and permitted dates window for the benchmark.
- Aditya: confirm that $7.5k can be approved from field-level credits. If not, list alternatives (e.g., 50k token top-up + 30-day extension).
- Markus: I'll draft the outbound message to Sam and include the HubSpot link and the MOU.

Let's aim to send NovaHealth our conditional offer by Monday COB (Nov 16) to meet their Nov 17 internal review ask.

Naomi

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the RFP materials. We reviewed internally and can support your benchmark window with a conditional package. Summary below: 

Offer (conditional):
- 30-day trial extension (active through Dec 20, 2026)
- Evaluation credit: $7,500 USD (equivalent to ~100,000 tokens under our pricing bands) dedicated to benchmark runs only
- Or, upon request, a strict token cap of 100,000 tokens in lieu of the dollar credit (we will enforce a hard stop).

Conditions:
1) Signed MOU confirming the scope of the benchmark (evaluation-only, no production traffic, permitted benchmark dates).
2) A completed procurement acknowledgement (procurement@novahealth.com to confirm internal approval).
3) Execution of our standard NDA (attached) if not already in place.
4) Benchmark results may be shared in aggregated form; raw prompt dumps must be pre-cleared to avoid leaking PHI/PII or disallowed content.

Next steps:
- I've attached a 1-page MOU + NDA stub (signed_ndas.pdf) and a HubSpot deal link for your records: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NOVA-2026-049
- If those documents look good, please sign the MOU and return it to us. Once we receive the signed MOU and procurement confirmation, we'll issue the credit and extend the trial. Credits will expire 30 days from issuance.

If you prefer a token cap instead of a dollar credit, let us know and we'll provision it directly to the trial project.

Appreciate the opportunity to compete — we're confident Redwood's serving economics will be compelling in your throughput runs. Reach out if you want a short runbook from our SRE team to ensure fair test conditions.

Best regards,

Naomi Feldman
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
